meta.title: Methanol synthesis flowsheet example (assisted first draft)
unknowns: The source gives no equipment tags, instrument tags, control valves, controllers, manual valves, relief devices, interlocks or operating limits; none are represented.

The source does not give the order of the pre-reactor compressor and pre-reactor heater relative to each other. It states only that both are pre-reactor and that the feeds are mixed before reaching reaction conditions. Streams from the feed mixer through the compressor and heater to the reactor are therefore not drawn.

The source does not state where the turbine and cooler sit relative to the reactor and the Flash unit, so no streams connect the reactor, turbine, cooler and Flash unit. The degrees-of-freedom list on L60 names the units, but the source does not say that list is in process order.

The recycle case (sections 4-5) sends most Flash vapor 'back to the start of the process' with a 10-50% purge to the exhaust. The recycle destination, the splitting equipment and the recycle stream are not specified, so the recycle is not drawn.
Section 3.2 refers to a 'process diagram in section 2.2', but no diagram is present in the source.

Engineering units of measure, pressures, temperatures, flows, line sizes, materials and equipment dimensions for the plant are not specified as plant data. The source is a simulation notebook and states that it does not represent any particular chemical process.
assumptions: Symbol dimensions and locations are proposed drafting geometry, not plant dimensions.
All unit identifiers (M-1, C-1, E-1, R-1, T-1, E-2, F-1) are newly assigned because the source supplies no tags.
The turbine has no supported symbol type, so it is represented with the closest supported type (compressor) and keeps the source name 'Turbine'.
The pre-reactor heater and the cooler are represented as heat_exchanger type.
The feed mixing named on L10 is represented as a feed_header unit (M-1).
The Flash unit is represented as separator type.
The liquid methanol Product block and the exhaust are represented as battery limits (BL), not as equipment.
Stream S3 (Flash vapor to exhaust) is interpreted from L73, which describes Flash vapor going to the exhaust. This is an interpretation for review.
The model represents the base (no-recycle) flowsheet; the recycle variant is recorded in unknowns.
